violet-marketing: Quick brief 1: we need a "mini kit" of launch visuals for the campaign + webinar. Compact set: 1 hero, 1 benchmark slide, 5 micro-explainers, 12 social variants. Deliverables: Figma components, PNG/SVG exports, and one short GIF for hero. Locales: en/de. Deadline: Thurs EOD (3 business days). Who can pick this up?

omar-design: I can take lead. Need precise export sizes and copy limits. Any special brand/legal constraints? :memo:

violet-marketing: Priority list: hero (landing + webinar banner), benchmark slide (single canvas with editable sparkline), micro-explainers (cache, batching, kv cache, routing tiers, graceful fallback), social pack (12). Brand: primary palette only, minimal accents. Keep copy tight: headline <=10 words, body <= 18 words.

omar-design: Proposed spec:
```
- Hero: 1600x900 PNG @2x, GIF 800x450 loop
- Benchmark slide: 1200x628 PNG + PDF, editable sparkline layer
- Micro-explainers: 1080x1080 and 1200x628 PNGs, SVG icon set
- Social: 1200x628, 1080x1080, 820x312 exports
- Filenames: mini_kit_<asset>_<locale>_v1.<ext>
```
Good to go?

kai-creative: Style direction: flat geometric icons, thin strokes, subtle panel shadow, tiny token sparkle in hero GIF (2 frames). I'll mock two frames tonight.

riley-solutions: Tech note: avoid absolute numbers or SLA-like claims. Use phrasing like "typical token savings" or "lower cost tier". I'll loop eng-ml for a 15-min accuracy pass once designs are in.

nora-product: I'll supply final copy by tomorrow AM. Reminder: add footnote: "Performance varies by model and workload." Also ensure routing tiers labelled: low-cost, balanced, high-accuracy.

brandbot: Brand checklist: colors: #0A2540 (primary), #0B6FFF (accent), #14D1A1 (accent2). Use Redwood Sans family. Contrast >= 4.5:1 for body. Spacing tokens s-8/s-16. No font substitutions.

omar-design: Thanks. Quick Q: animation export format? GIF ok or prefer MP4? GIF preferred for social; we'll also provide MP4 if needed.

violet-marketing: GIF is fine. Also provide one MP4 hero for demo playback.

omar-design: Owners: Omar - design lead; Kai - motion; Nora - copy; Riley - eng reviewer; Violet - campaign owner. I'll start a Figma component file and drop first pass (hero + 2 microcards) by EOD tomorrow. Tagging localization spreadsheet when ready.

kai-creative: I'll add two motion frames and export GIF + MP4 variants.

riley-solutions: Preparing a short review checklist: no hard numbers, avoid implied SLAs, verify terminology with eng-ml. Will ping once mockups land.

violet-marketing: Please use filename conv `mini_kit_<asset>_<locale>_v1.png` etc. Localization: en/de only. Ensure copy tokens for CTAs: Register / Learn more / View benchmark.

omar-design: Roger. Tracking in the marketing board under "mini kit sprint". Will label frames for localization notes.

violet-marketing: Thanks team 680. If anything blocks, flag early.

omar-design: Will do. :thumbsup:
